summary: CheerPlanner 2.0 messaging tile relocation + end-to-end SEND verified. Backend: /api/team/broadcast/send dry_run returns sms_configured=true with preview; real send to throwaway member returns sent=1, failed=0. Frontend: 'Messaging' tile is visible on Team Hub with testID team-tool-messaging immediately after team-tool-roster (Roster top=168px, Messaging top=256px). Tapping Messaging opens the 'Message parents' screen. Full UI flow (choose people -> select throwaway athlete -> compose -> Review & send -> Send now) shows Delivery summary '1 Sent, 0 Failed, 0 No phone'. Roster '...' menu still exposes 'roster-menu-broadcast' entry pointing to /team/broadcast (grep-confirmed at roster.tsx:436). No React Native / deprecated-package issues introduced by this change.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: the Team Hub screen's loadUnread() fires on every RealtimeContext refetch AND on focus; during heavy testing this triggered many 429s on /team/members/pending-count. Consider a small debounce or a single stale-time cache so the Members tile / pending-alert don't flicker when the rate limiter kicks in.
critical_code_review_comments: team.tsx TOOLS array now correctly orders 'roster' -> 'messaging' at indices 0,1; Members tile is rendered before the TOOLS map when isOwner=true, so the top-of-hub order is Members -> Roster -> Messaging as requested.
broadcast.py send flow post-refactor still returns sms_configured / preview in dry_run and uses send_bulk for real sends; both paths verified via test_broadcast_send_e2e.py.
seed_data_creation: Test creates a throwaway roster athlete (ZZ MsgTest, +12015550188) per test/run and deletes it in teardown so no residual data. No broadcast delete endpoint exists — one test broadcast row per run remains in db.broadcasts but is harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Messaging tile testID is team-tool-messaging and it lives at index 1 of TOOLS[] in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/team.tsx. Backend send endpoint requires an https base_url; use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. To avoid texting real people while Twilio is live, always create a throwaway athlete with a 555-01xx phone (see agent_to_agent_context_note) and message only that member. UI test dismisses the onboarding tour ('Skip') before checking tile order.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature-verification pass, not a bug hunt. The referenced sign-up-sheet regression risk (send_bulk refactor breaking the send path) is disproven: both dry_run and real send succeed end-to-end from the UI and via direct API.
